text:
rachael: hi! rachael here, first week backend. quick question: what's the right flow for asking about VPN, badge pickup, laptop swap, and infra permissions so i don't spam everyone?

samir: hey rachael, welcome! short: post general help in #help. for physical stuff (badge/laptop) tag @it-support and use #people-ops for desk/benefits.

taylor: adding a compact checklist:
- badge/laptop -> #people-ops + mention @it-support
- vpn -> #help and run the vpn setup guide link (search onboarding VPN)
- infra roles (aws/github/etc) -> run `/request-access` in #help with service and owner
- tokens/keys -> never paste in channels; use the vault ticket or DM the SRE oncall

devx-bot: Tip: run `/request-access --service=<service> --owner=@team --reason=onboarding` to start the access flow. Docs: https://internal/docs/onboarding/access

lee: For etiquette: always start threads for follow ups, include what you've tried, and tag the team owner (e.g., @eng-infra). Avoid @channel unless it's truly org-wide. :wave:

samir: For requests that might block others (deploy-blocking), use #eng-oncall and @oncall. Non-urgent reviews or pairing -> post in #eng or #new-hires depending on whether it's onboarding-specific.

rachael: where do i ask for a pairing buddy or quick review during week 1?

taylor: pairing buddy -> #new-hires or #eng with a short header: timezone, stack, ~1hr window. code reviews -> request direct reviewers or post a quick note in #eng-reviews with PR link. keep it short.

rachael: thanks, that helps. any bots to opt into for deploys / infra notices?

lee: yep, opt into build/deploy alerts in #devex-welcome (react with :bell:) or run `/notify me deploys` from devx-bot. if you're doing work that touches infra, opt into SRE alerts for the duration.

rachael: perfect — filing access requests and pinging it now. appreciate the pointers! :rocket:
